items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Now I got Elvin Sue Robison from New Orleans. Eddie Robison, call him Rabbit on drums.

ctx.x: And he promised me, up until the last minute we started rehearsing. Now we rehearsed in the Laperunas, Reno. That was downtown. That was where Harry Wells and all of them put that down there. He was a prize fighter. That was a great big place. The show with it in there. And the first day, I went to Annole's house to get him to come, he wouldn't show up. So, after I done signed the contract, they wouldn't stand for me to back down. They told me, if I had never played on a show, that they would show me everything…
